# Mr.Helper

> Mr.Helper is India's trusted home services marketplace app that connects users with KYC-verified local service providers for plumbing, electrical work, AC repair, cleaning, painting, carpentry, and other home maintenance services.

## About
Mr.Helper was created to bridge the gap between skilled local service providers and households in need. The platform focuses on Trust, Location-based matching, and Verification. Every provider undergoes strict KYC verification ensuring safety and quality.

## Founded
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Warangal, Telangana, India
- Founders: Karthik (CEO), Vamshi Krishna (CFO), Sai Harshith Goud (CMO)

## Services Offered
- Plumbing: Leak repairs, pipe fitting, tap installation, bathroom maintenance
- Electrical: Wiring, switch installation, appliance repair, electrical maintenance
- AC Repair: AC servicing, installation, gas filling, cooling issue resolution
- Cleaning: Home cleaning, office cleaning, deep cleaning, sanitation
- Painting: Interior painting, exterior painting, wall textures, waterproofing
- Carpentry: Furniture assembly, repairs, modular kitchen, woodwork
- Home Maintenance: General household repairs and maintenance

## Key Features
- 100% KYC-verified service providers
- Location-based matching for quick service
- Real-time booking and tracking
- Smart push notifications
- Transparent pricing with no hidden charges
- Rating and review system
- Secure admin approval system

## Service Areas
- Warangal, Telangana
- Kazipet, Telangana
- Hanamkonda, Telangana
- Expanding to Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, and other Indian cities
